meta.title: Learn OpenCode
meta.description: Understand OpenCode AI coding agent design and implementation from scratch

home.hero_subtitle: Understand AI coding agent design from scratch, one mechanism at a time
home.core_pattern_desc: Every AI coding agent shares the same loop: call the model, execute tools, feed results back. Production systems add policy, permissions, and lifecycle layers on top.
home.learning_path_desc: 10 progressive sessions, from a simple loop to a complete agent system
home.layers_desc: Five orthogonal concerns that compose into a complete agent
home.architecture_desc: Five layers compose into a complete AI coding agent. Each layer builds on the one below it.

timeline.title: Learning Path
timeline.subtitle: s01 to s10: Progressive Agent Design

layers.tools: What the agent CAN do. Tools give the model capabilities to interact with the world.
layers.planning: How work is organized. From category routing to subagent dispatch.
layers.extensibility: Extend agent capabilities through the plugin system.
layers.concurrency: Non-blocking execution. Background threads for parallel work.
layers.platform: Platform layer for configuration and session management.

session_details.s01_desc: The core while-loop pattern: call model → execute tools → feed results back. This is the foundational architecture of every AI coding agent.
session_details.s02_desc: Tool registration and execution via a dispatch table. Adding a new tool is one line in the dispatch map.
session_details.s03_desc: Permission check gate before dangerous operations. Protects the user environment while maintaining automation.
session_details.s04_desc: Lifecycle hook system allowing plugins to inject behavior at different stages without modifying core loop code.
session_details.s05_desc: 8 task categories (quick, deep, visual-engineering, etc.) each with different execution strategies and model configs.
session_details.s06_desc: 10 named subagents (oracle, explore, librarian, etc.) each with domain expertise, dispatched via @mention.
session_details.s07_desc: SKILL.md file system with priority-based loading. Project skills > personal skills > built-in skills.
session_details.s08_desc: @opencode-ai/plugin package with complete Hooks API covering config, tool, permission, chat lifecycles.
session_details.s09_desc: Background task execution allowing the agent to keep reasoning while slow operations complete elsewhere.
session_details.s10_desc: opencode.jsonc global configuration and session management. One config file controls the entire agent harness.
